name: Y.D. More Investments Ltd
summary: Y.D. More Investments Ltd is a privately owned Investment Manager. The firm engages in capital market activities in Israel. The company operates through Investment Portfolios, Pension Funds, and Management of Provident Funds segments. It is involved in managing mutual funds, securities portfolios for clients, investment funds, providing trading services in foreign securities, and financial assets brokerage activity. The firm was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Ramat Gan, Israel.
